title: AirWatch: City AQI Monitor
context: Pollution boards publish hourly AQI from many stations. Citizens want alerts and trends; officials want the worst stretches and areas.
input: Hourly AQI per station (arrays); a city grid of pollution readings.

milestones.title: Hours per category
milestones.requirement: Count hours in each AQI category (count array over category ids); most common category.

milestones.title: Polluted zone size
milestones.requirement: Size of the connected polluted region on a city grid containing a given cell (flood fill).

milestones.title: Pollution in a city block
milestones.requirement: 2-D prefix sums over a grid of sensor readings; the total for any rectangular block in O(1).

milestones.title: Worst 3-hour window
milestones.requirement: Highest 3-hour total with a fixed window.

milestones.title: Hours in a band
milestones.requirement: Sorted readings: hours with AQI in [200, 300) via two lower bounds.

milestones.title: Hours until it gets worse
milestones.requirement: For each hour, hours until a higher AQI (monotonic stack).
